description: Drenagem - Brasil - 2012 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Base de dados geográficos em formato vetorial de drenagem do território nacional obtido da Base Hidrográfica Ottocodificada (BHO) utilizada pela ANA (Agência Nacional de Águas) na gestão de recursos hídricos é obtida a partir do Mapeamento Sistemático Brasileiro (2012). [CNPGL]. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are base de dados geográficos, CNPGL, dado cartográfico, drenagem, hidrografia. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
